title: Crazy pool vortex
summary: Physics Girl shows a vortex phenomenon (a falaco soliton) that can be reproduced in a pool on a sunny day. Two vortices are created with plates and made visible with food coloring.
why: Cited as a concrete demonstration of vortex linkage, and as a better source link than the original submission.

quote.text: Physics Girl creates two vortices in a pool with plates and dyes the fluid flow between them with food coloring.
